title: Add your first recurring payment
ledger_help: Create a ledger to keep related payments together, for example your household bills.
category_help: Open Categories and set a schedule for a bill such as internet. Create a group first if the ledger has none.
payment_help: Open the first scheduled payment and enter the details you already know.
automatic_help: Open the first scheduled payment when it is available. The schedule creates it automatically.
completed: Your recurring payment is set up
integration_optional: You can keep entering payments yourself or connect an integration to fill in bill details.
demo_help: Open Categories in the sample ledger and choose First payment on a scheduled category to see a saved example.
load_error: Could not check the next step for this ledger.
demo_payment_unavailable: This category has no saved payment to preview. Choose another example in Categories.
